mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of months where UNRATE declines by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and deceleration in monthly CPI growth signals successful monetary policy tightening that avoids recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL MoM change falls > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%), a monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%), SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of months where UNRATE rises by more than 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1800 thousand units) signals strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 1800.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5 index points signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5 index points in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of months where INDPRO falls by more than 0.5 index points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales by more than 0.5% each in the past month signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 3%), a monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 3%), SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of months where UNRATE falls by more than 0.1pp.
